Noor also offered to bring vegan tacos. At the library, Leo spoke with Andy, who invited Leo to join him for early morning sketching sessions at the park, which Leo accepted. They planned to meet at the park at 6 AM next Tuesday.

During another conversation at Caroline's Café around 06:00, Caroline praised Leo's improvisation with the birds, and they discussed their AI music project further. They decided to make their meetings regular and Caroline also expressed her interest in practicing her latte art with Leo. Leo agreed to this plan, expressing his excitement for the collaboration.

Later, Leo and Andy had a conversation at the theater around 08:00. Andy invited Leo to meet him at Caroline's Café the next day at 3 PM to discuss their AI project and share new sketches. Leo agreed, and they planned to discuss the AI project and possibly sketch together. Their upcoming schedules include an AI project brainstorming session at the cafe on January 16, with participants Andy, Leo, Noor, and possibly Caroline.

data.content: Talked to Diego at hospital around 2026-01-15 09:00

Diego: Hey Leo, great running into you here at the hospital. I wasn't expecting to see you today.

Leo: Hey Diego, I was just playing my violin at the park and thought I'd stop by. It's good to see you, especially since we've got that catch-up scheduled tomorrow at Caroline's, right?

Diego: Absolutely! Tomorrow at 1 PM, just like we agreed. I'll bring some vegan tacos for us, as usual.

Leo: Sounds perfect! Looking forward to it. Let's discuss our AI project and those broken amps. Maybe we can even invite Noor and Mei for some additional input.

Diego: That sounds like a plan. I'll send a message to everyone and confirm the details. See you tomorrow at Caroline's.
Talked to Peter at park around 2026-01-15 13:00

Peter: Hey Leo, I ran into you at the park. Haven't seen you here in a while.

Leo: Hey Peter! Yes, been busy with the theater and my violin lately. How about those AI project discussions?

Peter: Ah yes, Diego and I were just at Caroline's Café discussing it. We're meeting again tomorrow at 2 PM. Fancy joining us?

Leo: Sounds great, Peter. I could use some good coffee and a chat. Let's make it 3 PM instead, if that works for you. I've got a few things to wrap up first.

Peter: 3 PM it is then, at Caroline's Café. Bring your violin, let's see if we can jam a bit.

Leo: You got it, Peter. Looking forward to it. Let's catch up on everything! (Added to Peter's schedule: 2026-01-16 15:00 @ Caroline's Café: AI music project meeting with Peter and Leo)
(Added to Leo's schedule: 2026-01-16 15:00 @ Caroline's Café: AI music project meeting with Peter)
Talked to Noor at library around 2026-01-15 14:00

Noor: "Hey Leo, I've been thinking about our AI music project. Would you like to share your new violin piece at our meeting tomorrow at Caroline's Café, 3 PM? I'll bring some vegan tacos too."

Leo: "Sounds great, Noor! I'd love to perform and enjoy some tacos afterward. See you there!"

Noor: "Looking forward to it. By the way, have you heard about Andy's early morning sketching sessions at the park next Tuesday? He invited me and suggested we join you for some fresh air and inspiration."

Leo: "Oh, that sounds wonderful! I'd be happy to have you both join me. Let's make it 6 AM then. See you at the park!"
Talked to Andy at restaurant around 2026-01-15 15:00

Andy: Hey Leo, great running into you at the park! I was just sketching the sunrise and thought of our meetings at Caroline's. How about we continue our discussion on the AI project there next Tuesday at 3 PM?

Leo: Sounds perfect, Andy! I'm excited to share my latest violin piece with you. How about we make it a tradition to enjoy vegan street tacos at the park afterward? And, speaking of traditions, I accepted your invite for early morning sketching sessions, let's meet at the park next Tuesday at 6 AM.

Andy: That sounds fantastic! I'll see you then. And hey, I've been meaning to ask, would you be interested in joining the cat and community garden discussions at the park next Saturday at 2 PM?

Leo: I'd love to, Andy! I've always enjoyed helping out at the community garden. See you at the park next Tuesday and Saturday!
